name: fivem-resource-audit
description: Use when a FiveM change spans resources, ownership is uncertain, dependencies or public APIs change, or an architecture audit is requested.
---

# FiveM Resource Audit

Read `AGENTS.md`, inspect manifests and dependencies, trace events, exports, callbacks, NUI callbacks, database tables, and consumers, and use `tools/cm-fivem-map/scan.py` when useful. Treat source as authoritative, identify the owner resource with evidence, and do not modify resources during an audit unless implementation is requested.
